props.title: 20 red checks, 14 decisions
props.subtitle: Every remaining failure is a choice only you can make. Pick, add a note, then Copy JSON back into the chat.

props.content:
- **51** checks failed on 09-23. The recorded run today: **328 passed, 24 failed** (`run-dna-ratchet.js --record`).
- **4 of the 24** were timeouts under load; all passed at load 11.7.
- The **20 real reds** map onto the cards below. Nothing else is left that I can fix without you.
- Held: wave 2 (verdict scanner, stochastic validation, semantic-control merge) — another session is editing `core/eval` and `core/exec`.

items.title: What should the core/domain control record be called?
items.insight: The struct holds per-operation **before/after observations** plus a verification result. The glossary calls that *evidence*; a *receipt* is a bundled completion proof.
items.detail:
- `dna/core/domain.dna.yaml:124` and `core/domain/AGENTS.md:25` (06-26) say **ControlReceipt**.
- The 06-17 sweep `92c476f13` renamed ~20 `*Receipt` types to `*Evidence`.
- Code is left at the committed `ControlReceipt` state until you rule.

options.label: ControlEvidence
options.desc: Rename back; amend the domain rule and AGENTS.md to match the glossary

options.label: ControlReceipt
options.desc: Keep the committed name; add a glossary exception

items.title: The testing package: what should its rules describe?
items.insight: 9 testing checks fail for one reason: an untested June checkpoint (`ea94550fc`, *Tested: not run*) deleted the portable test CLI, while `core/testing` grew daemon-bound proof code.
items.detail:
- The deletion reverted `43a567fe5`; it was a checkpoint, not a decision.
- Failing checks include `cli_binary_declared`, `zero_workspace_runtime_deps`, `six_test_classes`, `taxonomy_resolution_cascade`.

items.title: The TOON output router from PR #203: fold in or delete?
items.insight: PR #203 (a stale April branch) added `core/poly/src/handlers/output-router.ts`, a TOON formatter and `agent-detector.ts`. **Nothing imports them**, and the handler breaks the 3-handler poly rule.
items.detail:
- Fails `allowed_poly_handlers_only` (core/poly DNA + gates.yaml) and the poly `gates.test.ts` handler test.
- `agent-detector.ts` overlaps the existing robot-mode pipe detection.
